data.one_liner: A horizontal date picker widget taking up little screen space.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontal timeline-style date picker widget that allows users to select dates with one hand. It includes options for customizing colors, locale, and selectable day predicates.
use_when: You need a compact, always-visible date picker.
Users need to select dates easily using one hand in a horizontal scrolling timeline.
avoid_when: You need a traditional dropdown or popup calendar picker.
You require complex date-range selections or time picking.
strengths: Takes up very little screen space.
Supports custom colors, locales, and day predicates.
weaknesses: Limited to horizontal timeline date selection.
No built-in support for date-range picking.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it if you need a standard calendar dialog or date picker grid instead of a horizontal timeline.

data.minimal_example:
CalendarTimeline(
  initialDate: DateTime(2020, 4, 20),
  firstDate: DateTime(2019, 1, 15),
  lastDate: DateTime(2020, 11, 20),
  onDateSelected: (date) => print(date),
  leftMargin: 20,
  monthColor: Colors.blueGrey,
  dayColor: Colors.teal[200],
  activeDayColor: Colors.white,
  activeBackgroundDayColor: Colors.redAccent[100],
  dotsColor: Color(0xFF333A47),
  selectableDayPredicate: (date) => date.day != 23,
  locale: 'en_ISO',
)
